name: Agency Client Onboarding
description: End-to-end onboarding workflow for a new agency client. Generates a campaign brief, SEO content plan, and landing page copy — then routes each deliverable to the assigned agent and notifies via Slack.

steps.title: Create campaign brief
steps.description_template: Campaign brief for new client: {client_name}. Industry: {industry}. Goal: {goal}.

steps.title: Generate SEO content plan
steps.description_template: SEO content plan for {client_name}. Target keywords: {keywords}. Industry: {industry}.

steps.title: Write landing page copy
steps.description_template: Landing page copy for {client_name}. Product/service: {product}. Target audience: {audience}.
